text:
maria: Quick check — finalizing rate-limit header contract for per-route quotas. For soft 429s (grace/cooldown) do we want the runtime to return both a bucket hint and an explicit cooldown header, or keep it minimal? SDKs want something machine-readable to switch to degraded mode instead of hard retry. :thinking:

alex: +1 on machine-readable. Leaning to add `X-Redwood-Cooldown-Seconds` (int) for soft 429s, and keep `X-Redwood-Bucket` for client-side accounting. SDK can use cooldown to fall back to lower-cost model or reduce tokens. :+1:

sam: We should also consider an optional `X-Redwood-Quota-Estimate` (float 0..1) for near-term pressure signals. If missing, SDKs should treat as unknown and not change aggressive logic.

kevin: Can we have a tiny example response so SDK folks know what to parse?

maria: Example response suggestion:

```http
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Content-Type: application/json
X-Redwood-Bucket: route:chat-completions:12345
X-Redwood-Cooldown-Seconds: 30
X-Redwood-Quota-Estimate: 0.12
Retry-After: 30

{ "error": "rate_limited", "message": "soft quota hit: cooldown recommended" }
```

alex: SDK behavior proposal: on soft 429 (presence of `X-Redwood-Cooldown-Seconds`) -> do NOT immediate retry. Instead call `fallbackHandler()` which can reduce tokens / select a smaller model / rewrite prompt. If `Retry-After` is present and > cooldown, obey `Retry-After` for retries; otherwise use cooldown as advisory.

sam: Backcompat note: older clients will only see 429 + `Retry-After` which is fine. Document that `X-Redwood-Cooldown-Seconds` is advisory and may be omitted for strict hard-429s.

maria: Decision checkpoint: include `X-Redwood-Bucket` + `X-Redwood-Cooldown-Seconds`; `X-Redwood-Quota-Estimate` optional. SDKs should treat quota-estimate as advisory fraction of remaining capacity. Everyone ok?

kevin: Agree. I'll add parsing and a `onCooldown` callback to the JS/Go SDK PR. Will default to degrade-to-embedding-call in examples.

alex: Small nit: header casing—most proxies lowercase them, but spec should show canonical `X-Redwood-*`. Also add a short console docs note recommending degrade strategies and a sample pseudocode snippet.

deploy-bot: infra change to emit `X-Redwood-Cooldown-Seconds` scheduled: 2026-04-01 03:00 UTC :rocket:

maria: Action items: maria -> update spec PR with header names + examples; kevin -> SDK change; alex -> docs blurb + console example. I'll put the decisions in the PR description. Thanks all. :pray:
